fact_text: AirLink Communications began in 2010 as a distributor of PTCL's Evo WiFi USB sticks, which gave internet access in areas without fixed-line service.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink signed Huawei in 2011 as its exclusive Pakistan partner, and within about three years Huawei reached a 20 to 25 percent market share in the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink signed Samsung in 2015-16 and ran two competing brands through one distributor, which the CEO called a major operational task.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The Device Identification Registration and Blocking System, which the CEO said he worked with government to introduce, largely ended the smuggling of mobile phones into Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: A Made in Pakistan handset policy followed the registration system, and the CEO said about 98 percent of phones sold in Pakistan are locally made.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's CEO said he is senior vice chairman of the All Pakistan Mobile Manufacturing Association.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink brought Apple's iPhone into Pakistan in 2019, after the registration system had cut smuggling, and it distributes iPhone and Samsung handsets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: In 2019 AirLink added Xiaomi, TECNO and itel so that it could cover the whole handset market, from entry-level models up to high-end phones.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: In 2020 AirLink set up a manufacturing facility through its wholly owned subsidiary Select Telecom, which began making Xiaomi phones and also made TECNO and itel phones.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's 2021 IPO raised about PKR 6.3 billion, which the CEO described as the largest IPO in Pakistan's corporate history.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink also makes appliances, including Xiaomi televisions, and the CEO said it is the only listed Pakistani company doing both appliance manufacturing and mobile distribution.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said AirLink holds ISO certification and a German certification, and that it follows formal corporate governance standards.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's retail network has about 19 flagship stores in major malls, including Dolmen, Packages, Emporium and Lucky Mall in Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink signed for Pakistan's first Apple-branded iPhone mono store, under construction in Dolmen Mall Lahore and expected to open within about 1 to 1.5 months, with a listing on Apple's website.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said AirLink plans about 10 more iPhone mono stores in Pakistan, to be opened gradually, with the first ones targeted within about one year of January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink makes laptops under agreements with S Gadgets and Acer Gadgets, and it both assembles some laptops locally and imports others.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: Mobile phones make up about 85 percent of AirLink's sales, while TVs and laptops make up about 15 percent.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said AirLink distributes almost all major phone brands in Pakistan and plans more own retail stores, to capture retail margin and sell phones directly at lower prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink assembles almost all models of the Xiaomi, TECNO and itel brands, and it adds new models as those brands release them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The new facility was almost ready in January 2026, and the CEO said manufacturing would start in phases within about 10 to 15 days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's new facility is in a tax-free zone with tax exemption until 2035, which the CEO called the biggest tax advantage of the move.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink plans a phased move, starting with about 20 percent of production in the new facility and raising the share every 15 to 20 days so the market keeps being supplied.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO expects phones, laptops and TVs to be fully moved into the new facility by about June 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: After the move, AirLink plans to use its existing facility for home appliances and e-bikes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink set up a new company, Zexo Technologies, for e-bikes and home appliances, with an investment of about PKR 20 crore reported in January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said Zexo's partner brands are under NDA and still being negotiated, with a decision expected within about one month of January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's current production runs at about 40 percent of capacity, which leaves about 60 percent of capacity free for new export orders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said AirLink could start exporting within one to two months of an export rebate decision, because overseas brands can redirect customers to Pakistan-made models.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: Mobile phone sales in Pakistan fell about 20 to 25 percent during 2025, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: An 18 percent sales tax on phones took effect in 2025, raising handset prices overnight and hitting sales, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink maintained its EPS in the first quarter of FY26 despite the sales dip, and management's main focus is to keep EPS steady.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's EPS was PKR 12 in FY25, and management's target is to exceed that level in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said investors judge a company by earnings per share rather than by sales volume, which is why AirLink focuses on EPS.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's gross margins improved during 2025, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO expects gross margins to improve further, helped by the move into the tax-free zone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO expects a gradual sales recovery until 5G launches in Pakistan, after which a sharp rise is expected as buyers who are waiting for 5G phones make purchases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: A global chipset shortage could push mobile phone prices up by a further 20 to 25 percent, according to the CEO, and the problem is not specific to Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said AirLink will try to limit how much the chipset-driven price rise reaches consumers, focusing on the price bracket where Pakistani phone demand is highest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO expects EPS to rise by about PKR 3 to 4 after gross margins improve and the tax-free zone move takes effect.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said fixed costs fall automatically once all production is under one roof in the new facility.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink has no final car plan yet; any car operation would be a separate setup in Karachi, near the port, so that imports and exports move easily.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said Xiaomi's car plan for Pakistan depends on right-hand-drive production, which Xiaomi has not yet started, and talks can begin only once it does.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The mobile industry is asking for an 8 percent export rebate, which the CEO called normal, while Vietnam, Bangladesh and India give export incentives.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The export rebate was described as near its final stage, after a meeting with the Prime Minister and the full team in January 2026, with a decision hoped for within January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said the IMF does not strictly block an export rebate, and the government mainly needs to complete its internal homework on the proposal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO said government hesitation is about cost: an 8 percent rebate on USD 5 billion of exports would cost about USD 400 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: The CEO argued that USD 5 billion of exports adds about USD 1.5 billion of value, so after a USD 400 million rebate the government would still keep about USD 1.1 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's handset manufacturing employs about 400 people, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)

fact_text: AirLink's new manufacturing facility is about 1.4 million sq ft, roughly seven times the previous one, and was almost ready, with manufacturing phases due to start 10 to 15 days after 22 Jan 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First iPhone Mono Store? AirLink CEO Explains Expansion Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-22)
